incident_identifiers.name: Marshall Fire
incident_identifiers.fema_declaration: DR-4634-CO (Colorado Marshall Fire and Straight-line Winds), incident period beginning 2021-12-30
incident_identifiers.nwcg_incident_number_reason: No CO-BOX-style incident number was found in accessed sources.
incident_identifiers.ignition: Two ignitions (investigative summary p. 2): the Eldorado Springs Fire, then the Trailhead Fire roughly one hour later. No ignition clock time is published; the AAR records the 911 dispatch at 11:05 MST (18:05Z) to a line down near Marshall Rd and Eldorado Springs Rd where a fire had developed.

missing_layers.fire_progression_reconstructed: No expert (NIST-style) reconstructed arrival isochrones for Marshall were found. AAR fire_arrival events (reported) and FIRMS/FEDS are the only progression evidence.

missing_layers.street_imagery: Not acquired: Mapillary needs a token (none available); KartaView keyless API not attempted.

census-acs-2020-5yr-co.provider: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 2016-2020 5-year summary file (sequence format), Colorado tracts and block groups
census-acs-2020-5yr-co.vintage_choice: The 5-year period ending 2020, the year before the fire (released 2022-03-17, after the fire; irrelevant for retrospective replay). Uses 2020 block-group geography.
census-acs-2020-5yr-co.subset_method: tools.marshall_extract.extract_acs: estimate and MOE cells for B01001, B01003, B11001, B25044, B25046 for every block group in the TIGER subset, read by LOGRECNO from g20205co.csv and sequences 0001, 0002, 0035, 0119

census-tiger-2020-bg-co.provider: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2020 block groups, Colorado
census-tiger-2020-bg-co.crs_note: NAD83 (EPSG:4269) longitude/latitude used as OGC:CRS84 without datum shift (sub-metre difference)
census-tiger-2020-bg-co.subset_method: tools.marshall_extract.extract_block_groups: stdlib .shp/.dbf reader; polygons with any edge intersecting the bbox or containing its centre; rings reversed to RFC 7946 orientation
